checks: Decoded successfully at the locked 1024 by 1024 output size.

modalityReview.method: Full-resolution inspection plus a 320-pixel-per-panel Before/After card-size review.
findings: The fixed camera, counter, windows, bookcase, aisle and table sequence remain immediately recognizable.
Daylight shifts convincingly to a rainy midnight lounge with coherent walnut, blue upholstery and brass practical lighting.
The change is meaningful without becoming a different room, so the card explains controlled edit strength clearly.
At card size the source and result remain readable side by side and the requested transformation is obvious.

summary: Approved as the Qwen Edit family pilot: it is polished, clearly demonstrates a controlled whole-scene mood and material edit, preserves the source composition well, and remains as useful and legible as the selected Comfy edit references at card size.
knownLimitations: The intended midnight grade is dark when viewed alone; the locked Before/After presentation is required on the template card.
